title: MoleculesAI LLM Provider/Model/Runtime Registry SSOT
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for contracts/llm-registry/llm-registry.yaml — the single source of truth for the LLM PROVIDER catalog (vendors, base-URL templates, auth-env names, model-prefix regexes) and the per-runtime NATIVE MATRIX (RFC #340: which providers + exact model ids each runtime natively supports). molecule-core embeds this via go.moleculesai.app/sdk/gen/go/llmregistry; runtimes INHERIT their offering from the per-runtime matrix and pick from it, while each adapter OWNS how it translates a picked model to its runtime's API. Distinct from cloudproviders.yaml (compute backends) and registry.yaml (container image registry). tools/gen-llm-registry.mjs copies the validated instance to gen/go/llmregistry/llm-registry.yaml; .gitea/workflows/llm-registry-ssot-drift.yml pins gen/ to this contract.

schema_version.description: Schema/data revision. The Go/consumer loaders fail closed on a mismatch.

providers.description: The full provider catalog. Every runtimes[].providers[].name MUST reference a name here.

runtimes.description: runtime-name -> native support set (RFC #340). A runtime supports a SUBSET of the catalog, not the whole thing.

name.description: Stable catalog key (intended to align with llm_price_catalog.provider). Unique across the catalog.

auth_mode.description: e.g. anthropic_api | oauth | third_party_anthropic_compat | openai_compat_responses | wif_adc.

base_url_template.description: openai-protocol base URL (may use {var} placeholders resolved from endpoint_vars). Empty = SDK/CLI default.

base_url_anthropic.description: anthropic-protocol base URL where the provider exposes one.

auth_env.description: Env var NAMES accepted (never values); any one set satisfies auth.

auth_token_env.description: Env var the adapter projects the vendor key into (defaults ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN when empty).

model_prefix_match.description: RE2 regex unifying the proxy prefixes, canvas patterns, and adapter model_prefixes.

thinking_policy.description: Per-model request-shaping fact (e.g. require_enabled) consumers apply when dialing this entry.

upstream_vendor.description: Proxy upstream-vendor key {openai|moonshot|anthropic|minimax}; set only on routed entries.

wire_model_prefix.description: Prefix the proxy rewrites onto the wire model id for this upstream.

endpoint_vars.description: Named template vars interpolated into base_url_*; each resolves from an env var with a default.

display_name.description: Human label for the runtime picker.

name.description: References a providers[].name. Load fails closed if it does not resolve.

models.description: Exact model ids this runtime exposes for the provider (null/empty allowed only for name-only BYOK prefix-routing arms).
